text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up helping take care of Curren Bouquetd'or's racing outfit.
Looking at the spread-out fabric, it hit me once again.
choice_data_list: That's such a stylish racing outfit.
That's such a stylish racing outfit, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say that...
I'm sure the designer would be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
They were such a passionate and earnest person.
They gave form to... all of my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
Bouquet-san, through your racing,
you want to 'gift a bouquet to someone special.'

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—a bouquet of glory.
I wanted to express that resolve in 'black.'

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
And make it glamorous even with neutral colors...
Hmm... Ah! I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text: Let's turn you yourself into a bouquet!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Huh? Make me into... a bouquet...?

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOH! Inspiration is striking!
A silhouette like a face emerging from a vase!
With real flowers growing to make it stylish and cool—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...!
F-Fresh flowers? Is that a face peeking from the vase...?

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sure it will look great on you!
Ah! It's so unique and conceptual!
It's going to make such a huge impact♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Such sparkling eyes...
She truly, genuinely loves
fashion design—)

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! Oh, noooo!
I made it way too avant-garde again!
This is just a costume now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true...? 
Still, the novelty of it is... wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I'm sorry. I'm always like this...
People often praise my imagination, but I just don't have the skill to tie it all together..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I know I can bring them into harmony.
Every single element—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright with you...
Would you allow me to help?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—So you came to consult Curren?
When it comes to black, Curren's your girl, after all♪”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
If I could hear your thoughts for reference...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "First off, black tends to look heavy, so Curren was super particular about the shade!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So, I gathered pictures of cute black dresses from all over the world and studied their silhouettes and materials♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "And so—I'll lend you the scrapbook from that time~♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my—are you sure?
...Thank you very much.
I think this will be very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Encyclopedia of Historic Umamusume Racewear'...
This might be helpful too.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Come to think of it, the designer mentioned that they "weren't very knowledgeable about flowers"...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I should organize the photos of the pretty flowers
and their meanings in the language of flowers too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Right—having the real thing on hand
will definitely give me some hints.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Before the meeting—let's go buy some.

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting.
Oh my, those flowers are...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I thought this might serve as a reference...
I have also gathered—other materials.

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! Is this that Curren Chan-san's?! And this one is a flower encyclopedia? Is it handmade?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just put together some flower photos
and descriptions—briefly.
It's nothing special, really...

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
You're being far too humble...!
These materials are incredible...

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
You truly are like a flower.
Blooming so gorgeously,
yet completely tranquil, and gentle...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No, I—
I just... wanted to be of some help, if at all possible...

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
That beauty is just like... a bouquet hidden behind one's back before presenting it—
Th-That's it! Whoaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
I-It's done...!
This is it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—How lovely.
I think it's truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Designer
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Ah, thank goodness!
Then that settles the silhouette.
All that's left is the floral fabric...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In that case, going back to the earlier materials—
there are many flowers I'd love to introduce to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Let's definitely choose together—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The designer looked so truly happy back then...
It warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though it was a racing outfit for herself, I couldn't help but think how hard she had worked for someone else's sake...
choice_data_list: You really did try your best...!
It's perfect for someone as lovely as a flower like you.
It's perfect for someone as lovely as a flower like you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though it was a racing outfit for herself, I couldn't help but think how hard she had worked for someone else's sake...
choice_data_list: You really did try your best...!
It's perfect for someone as lovely as a flower like you.
It's perfect for someone as lovely as a flower like you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—! That person did so much for us...
I could never thank them enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meant to praise Curren Bouquetd'or, but she seemed unaware of just how hard she'd worked.
She simply gave a smile as gentle as a spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Huh... like a flower... you say...?
Even you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um... well... uh...
If it looks good on me... then I'm happy.
Thank... you very much—
